title: Stack loss with three candidate predictors
intro: Brownlee's 21 days of a nitric acid plant, with all three recorded variables: the air flow, the cooling-water temperature (°C) and the acid concentration (coded). The response is the stack loss. This fits stack loss on all three at once; the selection can drop a predictor that does not earn its place.

settings.Name: Stack loss
settings.Predictors: Air flow, Water temp, Acid conc
